workflow.title: Workflows
workflow.description: CI/CD pipelines as a DAG: build image, approve, deploy app and notify

list.name: Workflow
list.runsEmpty: No runs yet for this workflow.
list.deleteDescription: This removes the definition, its revision chain and run history. It is refused while any run is queued or running.
list.deleteBlocked: The workflow has queued/running runs. Cancel them first.
list.empty: No workflows yet. Create one to get started.
list.webhookHint: POST a git host push payload to this public endpoint; GitHub / Gitea / GitLab push events are adapted.
list.resetTokenConfirm: Resetting invalidates the old token immediately.
list.runParamsHint: Parameters are validated against the workflow schema; the run pins the current revision.

statuses.warningTooltip: {{count}} node(s) failed under continue semantics (pipeline not blocked)

editor.name: Name
editor.paletteHint: Nodes without incoming edges are start nodes (parallel starts allowed). Edges are dependencies; deleting a node cleans up its edges.
editor.nodeIdInvalid: Node id "{{id}}": only letters, digits and underscore (A-Za-z0-9_)
editor.emptyGraph: Add at least one node before saving.
editor.conflict: The workflow was modified by someone else. Reload and retry.
editor.selectNodeHint: Select a node on the canvas to edit it
editor.notifyFailureNote: Notify nodes are best-effort: a failure never blocks the pipeline (failure policy is always continue); the run is marked "Succeeded (warnings)"
editor.dollarTemplateWarning: Suspected hand-written template {{found}}: workflow templates use {{example}} syntax — the $ form is saved as literal text.
editor.nameInvalid: Name must be 1-63 characters with no leading or trailing spaces
editor.palettePlatformHint: Platform workflows do not support deploy-app nodes yet; bind a space to enable them. Nodes without incoming edges are start nodes.
editor.deployNodeNeedsSpace: Platform (unbound) workflows cannot contain deploy-app nodes; bind a space first
editor.yamlHint: Name, description, params and triggers are edited in the YAML document

yaml.notMapping: The document must be a YAML mapping
yaml.metadata: metadata must be a mapping with string name/description
yaml.spaces: spaces must be a list of strings
yaml.spec: spec must be a mapping with nodes and edges arrays
yaml.nodeIdRequired: Node #{{index}}: id must be a non-empty string
yaml.edgeInvalid: Edge #{{index}}: from/to must be strings referencing existing nodes

props.gitRefExprHint: The expression resolves at run time and is not checked against the branch list
props.gitRefManualHint: Ref list unavailable (both direct and build-cluster fetch failed) — enter the ref manually
props.gitRefUrlTemplated: Repository URL contains a variable — refs cannot be listed
props.gitRefLoadingProbe: Fetching refs via the build cluster — this may take a while…
props.gitRefProbeSource: Listed via the build cluster (direct fetch failed)
props.gitModeHint: server = Kite clones and uploads the build context; runtime = the build runtime (buildkitd) fetches the repo itself
props.dockerfileHint: Path mode: a file path in the build context; text mode: the full Dockerfile content; empty uses the default Dockerfile
props.dockerfilePreview: Preview the file at this path
props.dockerfilePreviewVarRef: A reference has no resolvable default and settles only at run time
props.dockerfilePreviewNeedsGit: Preview needs a git source to resolve the path
props.platformsHint: Target build platforms, multi-select; empty follows the build node's native platform
props.outputRefHint: Supports templates like registry/app:{{params.tag}} or registry/app:{{git.shortCommit}}
props.outputRefResolved: Pushes as {{ref}} via the default registry
props.tagTemplateHint: The auto-named tag; empty uses <commit>[-<fingerprint>]. The template is the final tag verbatim — no fingerprint appended. Variables: {{params.*}}, {{git.*}}, {{ctx.*}}, {{build.fingerprint}}
props.gitCredentialRefHint: Name of a stored git credential; empty = anonymous fetch
props.registryCredentialRefHint: Name of a stored registry credential; empty = anonymous push
props.deployRegistryCredentialRefHint: Registry credential used to pull the image; empty = keep the application's configured credential
props.lockedHint: Locked to the application entry target
props.imageHint: Empty = deploy the app's current config
props.assigneesHint: Any assignee or an admin may decide
props.assigneesNoDirectory: User directory unavailable — enter numeric user IDs, comma separated
props.spaceFixedHint: The deploy space is fixed to the workflow’s own space.
props.timeoutHint: On expiry the timeout action applies; empty = platform default

dockerfilePreview.notFound: This file does not exist in the build context
dockerfilePreview.notFoundAt: This file does not exist at commit {{commit}}

params.hint: Manual triggers render a form from this schema; webhook payloads and cron runs fall back to defaults. Reference values as {{params.name}}.
params.name: Name
params.nameInvalid: Parameter names must be non-empty and unique.
params.presetsHint: Click to add as an optional string parameter; cron / webhook triggers fall back to its default.

triggers.manualDesc: Trigger from the UI with a parameter form
triggers.webhookDesc: Public endpoint POST /api/workflow-hooks/:token with the workflow's token
triggers.cronDesc: 5-field expression, local timezone, minute-level built-in scheduler

run.retryDisabledHint: Only failed/cancelled/interrupted runs can be retried.
run.logHint: Click a node on the canvas
run.noLogs: No logs for this node yet.
run.decideForbidden: Only assignees of this approval or an admin may decide.
run.eventsEmpty: Events appear here as the run progresses.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.name: Name
credentials.gitDescription: Credentials for build nodes fetching private Git repositories. Stored encrypted, never displayed again after saving.
credentials.registryDescription: Credentials for pushing images and pulling private images on publish. Stored encrypted, never displayed again after saving.
credentials.gitAddressHint: Optional; identifies the Git service this credential is for.
credentials.keepPasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current password
credentials.createNote: The payload is write-only: it is stored encrypted and can never be read back.
credentials.editNote: Editing replaces the description and payload; non-secret fields are pre-filled and blank passwords keep the stored ones — only enter new or changed secrets.
credentials.deleteDescription: Workflows referencing this credential name will fail to build until reconfigured.
credentials.payloadRequired: Fill in the git or registry credential fields.
credentials.defaultInsecureHint: This host uses http:// — add it to the insecure registries in the build runtime settings, otherwise image pushes may fail.

buildProviders.title: Build Providers
buildProviders.description: Create Kubernetes (managed-cluster) or Docker build providers; they join the build fleet at runtime, without config changes or restarts.
buildProviders.name: Name
buildProviders.typeHint: Immutable after creation; Docker providers run builds on the kite host's docker daemon.
buildProviders.addressHint: Empty = the host's default docker daemon; remote tcp daemons cannot mount the shared buildkitd config and are not supported.
buildProviders.addressInvalid: The address must start with unix:// or tcp://, or be empty.
buildProviders.tlsSection: TLS (optional; file paths on the kite host)
buildProviders.nameHint: DNS-1123 label; unique across the build fleet.
buildProviders.nameImmutableHint: The name is immutable; workflows reference providers by name.
buildProviders.namespaceHint: Namespace receiving the buildkitd runtime pods.
buildProviders.nameInvalid: Name must be a DNS-1123 label (lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 63 chars max).
buildProviders.namespaceInvalid: Namespace must be a DNS-1123 label (lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 63 chars max).
buildProviders.modeHint: Pick the build mode; the two images are configured in the global build runtime settings.
buildProviders.cpuInvalid: CPU limit must be a positive number.
buildProviders.memoryInvalid: Memory limit must be a positive number (Gi).
buildProviders.podSpecHint: CPU / memory of the build pod when a workflow leaves capacity empty.
buildProviders.podCpuInvalid: Instance CPU must be a non-negative number.
buildProviders.podMemoryInvalid: Instance memory must be a non-negative number (Gi).
buildProviders.cacheHint: The GC schedule is a cron expression; image and size are required, StorageClass is optional. Unchecking skips the cache registry entirely.
buildProviders.cacheRequired: An enabled cache requires image, size and GC schedule.
buildProviders.readyTimeoutHint: Buildkitd pod-Ready poll timeout; prefilled with the module default.
buildProviders.readyTimeoutInvalid: Ready timeout must be a non-negative integer.
buildProviders.nodesHint: Pin buildkitd pods to the selected nodes (node affinity; the pods tolerate all taints). Empty = any node; switching the cluster clears the selection.
buildProviders.nodesLoadFailed: Failed to load the cluster's nodes.
buildProviders.notConfigured: buildfleet is not configured; add a buildfleet section to the kite config first.
buildProviders.deleteDescription: The provider is unregistered from the build fleet immediately; builds pinning it fail at run time until reconfigured.
buildProviders.deleteReferenced: Referenced by {{count}} namespace default(s); those builds will fail at run time until reconfigured.

buildRuntime.title: Build Runtime
buildRuntime.description: BuildKit images, node hosts, insecure registries and mirror mappings of the default runtime profile.
buildRuntime.hostsHint: Statically resolve hostnames to the given IP.
buildRuntime.insecureHint: Entries must start with http:// or https://.
buildRuntime.mirrorsHint: Completed mirror sources are added to insecure registries automatically (removable); they must start with http:// or https:// and carry no path suffix.
buildRuntime.imagesHint: Empty = the built-in default image; providers created here switch immediately, config-file providers need a restart.
buildRuntime.restartNote: Saving applies to providers created here immediately; docker-type insecure registries/mirrors and config-file providers need a kite restart.
buildRuntime.hostsRequired: Each host entry needs an IP and at least one hostname.
buildRuntime.hostIpInvalid: IP "{{ip}}" is invalid: expected a valid IPv4 address (e.g. 10.0.0.5).
buildRuntime.insecureInvalid: Insecure registry entry "{{entry}}" is invalid: expected http(s)://host[:port] with no path.
buildRuntime.mirrorsRequired: Each mirror needs a source registry and at least one mirror source.
buildRuntime.mirrorInvalid: Mirror source "{{source}}" is invalid: expected http(s)://host[:port] with no path suffix (buildkit swaps the host only and keeps the original path).
buildRuntime.loadFailed: Build runtime settings are unavailable; buildfleet may not be configured.

spaceSettings.noSpace: Select a space to configure space-level overrides.
spaceSettings.providerHint: Pick the build provider for this space; the (default) marker is the global default.
